rule: PREREG_R8 5.1 = PREREG_R7 5.1: a run is flagged iff the evaluator AUC is outside [min_s AUC_s - 0.02, max_s AUC_s + 0.02] (s = 0..9), |dMPPE| > 0.5 cm, SP-SR or MP-SR differs from the evaluator, or it is a problem run. Phase S: a candidate with a flagged run is validation_failed. Phase F: a flagged finalist run disqualifies the finalist. A kit / stock-runtime change fails the gate.
note: own-input check only (each run vs its OWN input track); nothing is selected
